diagonal-refinement.purpose: Optical compensation for visibly underweight diagonals, with exact parallel straight sides.

controls.measurement_units: font units / 1000 UPM; stroke width measured perpendicular to the edge, away from joins

diagonal-refinement.method: Before: signed point-to-line distance from an outer-edge point to the inner straight segment at recorded body heights; y coordinates are SVG-downward. Original w/W nonparallel edges are recorded as sampled ranges. After: exact distance between parallel edge lines; rounded to four decimals.

inspection.source_svg_status: read every affected path; recalculated joins from line intersections rather than repeated approximate vertices; source paths parse as closed filled shapes

w.reason: The two previous heavy legs were too light and had small slope differences. Both now use dx/dy=165/446 with 114-unit horizontal separation. Both pairs of thin rising edges are parallel; they retain their own 27–28-unit perpendicular family. All outer cap/baseline endpoints, 24-unit bottom wedges and overall advance remain. Inner vertices rise as expected when the heavy diagonals expand.

W.reason: A modest increase to 121.43 units gives the long diagonal stems slight optical compensation over H=116. Both heavy legs now share dx/dy=1/3. The small slope drift in each hairline has been removed. Existing 28/29-unit bottom wedges and overall side bounds remain; intersection vertices are computed from the actual edge lines.

v.reason: Widened the heavy stem by 8 horizontal units; perpendicular width rises from 98.42 to 105.85, matching lowercase stems. Both heavy edges retain dx/dy=0.4, and the 26.93-unit thin return is unchanged. Shifted the inner cap wedge corner by the same 8 units to retain its 45-degree edge.

y.reason: Exactly the same body correction as v. Original descending stroke and hooked terminal path retained unchanged.

x.reason: Original main diagonal used the vertical-stem horizontal width, producing only 88.20 perpendicular units. Widened symmetrically by 11 horizontal units per side to 106.50 perpendicular units. Main diagonal remains 2:3 and hairline remains 4:5. Wedge terminal edges remain 45 degrees; left/right sidebearings change by 11 units and need compiled spacing review.

X.reason: Original main diagonal was only 87.37 perpendicular units beside H=116. Expanded each heavy side symmetrically by 17.5 horizontal units to 116.49 perpendicular units. Preserved parallel 2:3 heavy edges, 4:5 thin edges, 45-degree wedge cuts. Sidebearings change by 17.5 units and need compiled spacing review.

V.reason: Already 115.51 perpendicular units, essentially the 116-unit H stem. Exact parallel diagonals and appropriate apparent weight in the current compiled specimen; no unnecessary widening.

findings: H/O and n/o base rhythm retained: triangular serif tips are close while main stem gaps remain evenly open.

Punctuation after overhangs is drawn closer so baseline marks attach to the preceding letter; colon and semicolon spacing retained.
